name: Social Inequality & Resilience
description: Films that look directly at the structures of inequality in Malagasy life — the gap between the city elite and the rural poor, the corruption that pervades official systems, the ingenuity and persistence of those who survive despite it. This is cinema that refuses both sentimentality and despair: it observes, it records, and it finds in everyday people a resilience that the language of development economics has no category for.
